_comment: Keyless (or key-optional) US government API endpoints that cover ground askamerica
does not, or covers more recently than the last ETL run. Surfaced by the MCP tool
suggest_external_sources. Deliberately excludes anything requiring a mandatory API
key (FRED, EIA, Congress.gov, GovInfo, OpenFEC), since the caller cannot supply one.
'complements' names the askamerica schema a source sits next to — that schema stays
the primary source; these are for gaps and recency only.
Endpoints drift. Treat every entry as a lead to verify, not a guarantee.

sources.name: National Weather Service API
sources.covers: Current conditions, forecasts, and active severe-weather alerts.
sources.gap: The weather schema holds NOAA GHCND daily historical observations; it has no forecast or live-alert data.
sources.notes: Requires a descriptive User-Agent header or requests are rejected. Returns GeoJSON.

sources.name: Federal Register API
sources.covers: Rules, proposed rules, notices, and presidential documents, published daily.
sources.gap: Documents published since the last ETL run.
sources.notes: Full-text search plus agency/date/type filters. Generous rate limits.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR submissions & XBRL company facts
sources.covers: Per-CIK filing index (/submissions/CIK##########.json) and all XBRL facts (/api/xbrl/companyfacts/).
sources.gap: Filings submitted since the last ETL run, and companies outside the ingested universe.
sources.notes: Requires a User-Agent header identifying the requester (name + email) per SEC policy; ~10 requests/sec. CIK must be zero-padded to 10 digits.

sources.name: USAspending API
sources.covers: Federal awards, contracts, grants, loans, and agency spending by recipient/geography/time.
sources.gap: Award-level detail and recent fiscal periods beyond the ingested aggregates.
sources.notes: Most search endpoints are POST with a JSON filter body, not GET.

sources.name: Treasury Fiscal Data API
sources.covers: Debt to the penny, daily/monthly Treasury statements, interest rates, exchange rates.
sources.gap: Daily-grain federal finance series that are not ingested at all.
sources.notes: Supports filter/sort/pagination via query params. No key, no strict rate limit.

sources.name: Census Bureau Data API
sources.covers: ACS, Decennial, Population Estimates, CBP, and other survey products at all geography levels.
sources.gap: Variables and survey vintages not selected during ETL.
sources.notes: Works without a key at low volume; a free key is recommended above ~500 calls/day. Exact variable codes required — check the vintage's /variables.json.

sources.name: Census Geocoding Services
sources.covers: Street address to coordinates, and coordinates to census tract/block/county FIPS.
sources.gap: resolve_geo maps place names to FIPS; this handles street addresses and lat/lon.
sources.notes: Batch geocoding accepts a CSV upload of up to 10,000 addresses.

sources.name: OpenFEMA API
sources.covers: Disaster declarations, public/individual assistance, NFIP claims and policies.
sources.gap: Declarations and assistance records since the last ETL run.
sources.notes: OData-style $filter/$select/$top query params; 1,000-record default page size.

sources.name: NVD CVE API
sources.covers: CVE records with CVSS scores, CPE match data, and references.
sources.gap: CVEs published or rescored since the last ETL run.
sources.notes: Keyless access is rate-limited to roughly 5 requests per 30s; a free key raises it. Paginate with startIndex/resultsPerPage.

sources.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
sources.covers: The full KEV catalog as a single JSON document, refreshed on publication.
sources.gap: KEV additions since the last ETL run.
sources.notes: One static file — fetch and filter locally rather than querying per CVE.

sources.name: USGS Water Services
sources.covers: Streamflow, gage height, and groundwater levels — real-time and historical.
sources.notes: Query by site, state, county, or bounding box. Real-time service keeps ~120 days; use the daily-values service for history.

sources.name: USGS Earthquake Catalog
sources.covers: Earthquake events by time, magnitude, and bounding box.
sources.gap: Seismic events are not in the disasters schema.
sources.notes: GeoJSON output; cap result size with minmagnitude and a time window.

sources.name: openFDA
sources.covers: Drug labels, adverse events, recalls, device reports, and food enforcement.
sources.gap: FDA product-level safety data, which the CDC/CMS-sourced health schema does not carry.
sources.notes: Keyless at ~240 requests/min; a free key raises it. Supports search + count aggregation server-side.

sources.name: BLS Public Data API (v1)
sources.covers: Any BLS time series by series ID — CPI, employment, wages, productivity.
sources.gap: Series IDs outside the ingested set, and releases since the last ETL run.
sources.notes: v1 is keyless but capped at 25 queries/day, 25 series and 10 years per request. v2 needs a free key. Requires exact series IDs.

sources.name: Data.gov CKAN catalog
sources.covers: Metadata search across every published federal dataset.
sources.gap: Use when no askamerica schema and no other source here fits — this finds who publishes the data at all.
sources.notes: package_search returns dataset metadata and distribution URLs, not the data itself. Last-resort discovery.
